items.title: Rockwell’s CEO Is Buying the 14% Crash, and His Last Dip Buy Is Up 37%
items.summary: Rockwell's stock cratered after a revenue miss, yet the quarter's real culprit was a one-time refund the company chose to pay. Now a CEO who mostly sells shares is writing a check, and the timing echoes a trade he made once before.
